# FlexiFund AI
> "When your income changes, your financial plan should change with it."

FlexiFund AI is a deterministic financial resilience product designed specifically for gig workers, freelancers, and irregular income earners in India.
It analyzes real user-provided financial transaction data through deterministic mathematical models to evaluate:
- Income volatility (Coefficient of Variation)
- Conservative planning baseline references
- Essential daily and monthly burn rates
- Emergency buffer coverage runway (when cash balance is provided)
- Avoidable bank charges and recurring discretionary outflows
- Financial pressure warning signals
- What-If sensitivity shocks
- Verified social security and worker welfare matching (e-Shram, PM-SYM, PM SVANidhi, PMJJBY, PMSBY, AB-PMJAY, BOCW, APY)
- Prioritized action plans
